parts.note: to plan is to project, as in a projected budget
ED is short for editor, the crossword's stock newsman

explanation.surface: A scheme that a journalist tossed aside.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Plan' looks like the definition but is the first piece; the definition is the verb phrase at the end.
explanation.definitionFit: To project something is to hurl or cast it forward, so the past tense matches having thrown it out.

clue.text: It is perilous removing ski getting between the lines

indicators.note: getting between tells us the jumbled letters sit inside the railway lines

parts.note: RY is the abbreviation for railway, the crossword's usual 'lines'

indicators.note: removing is read as re-moving, so the letters of ski are moved about

explanation.surface: A warning that taking off your skis when caught between rail tracks is dangerous.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface pictures a skier stuck on a railway; 'removing' is read as re-moving, and 'the lines' are railway lines. 'It is' just leads into the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Both words describe a situation full of danger or hazard.

clue.text: Lady hit out after obscure character had been cut short

indicators.note: after places the scrambled letters behind the shortened name
cut short means the name loses its final letter

parts.note: Jude is the title character of Thomas Hardy's novel Jude the Obscure

indicators.note: out signals that the letters of hit are put out of order

explanation.surface: A woman lashed out once a shadowy figure had been interrupted.
explanation.walkthrough: 'out' rearranges HIT into ITH; 'cut short' trims JUDE to JUD. 'Obscure' is the literary clue: Jude the Obscure is a Thomas Hardy novel.
explanation.definitionFit: Judith is a woman's given name, so it is an example of a lady.

clue.text: Firm has medal that is for left-winger

parts.note: CO is short for company, a firm
MM is the Military Medal, a British decoration
i.e. abbreviates id est, Latin for that is

explanation.surface: A company holds an award reserved for a socialist.
explanation.definitionFit: A commie is slang for a communist, someone on the political left.

indicators.note: disposition is read as a fresh arrangement, so the letters of stern are disposed anew

explanation.surface: Comment on the severe temperament of an artist from Germany.
explanation.walkthrough: 'disposition' looks like temperament but signals rearranging STERN; the 's is 'is'.
explanation.definitionFit: Max Ernst was a German-born Surrealist and Dada painter.

parts.note: a halt to gunfire is agreed, and the boundary drawn on the map is where it applies

explanation.surface: Instructions to troops to hold fire along a front.
explanation.definitionFit: A truce boundary is the line along which opposing forces agree to stop firing.

clue.text: Achieving a wrong mark for communicating one's ideas

parts.note: achieving something is getting it
a cross is the mark a teacher puts by a wrong answer

explanation.surface: Earning a black mark in exchange for making your point.
explanation.definitionFit: To get something across is the idiom for making others understand it.

parts.note: reads as calm forbearance, but means a doctor's way of dealing with someone who is ill

explanation.surface: A question about taking things calmly.
explanation.definitionFit: A doctor's manner towards those in their care is their tact and reassurance at the sickbed.

clue.text: Acknowledging young lady in a disreputable place

indicators.note: in puts the young lady inside the seedy venue

parts.note: a dive is a seedy bar or club
Miss is the title for a young unmarried woman

explanation.surface: Someone admitting a girl was found in a sleazy joint.
explanation.definitionFit: Admissive means admitting or conceding, so it is a synonym for owning up to something.

clue.text: Bond be inserted into false teeth

indicators.note: inserted into puts the word be inside the dental plate

parts.note: a denture is a set of artificial teeth

explanation.surface: A tie is placed into someone's dentures.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bond' suggests a link or a spy, but here it is the financial sense.
explanation.definitionFit: A debenture is a type of long-term loan certificate issued by a company, a kind of financial bond.

indicators.note: untidy signals the letters of study being messed up

explanation.surface: A messy, grimy room where someone works.
explanation.definitionFit: Something covered in dust is grimy or unclean.

definitions.meaning: Mr is a form of address placed before a name
a right of ownership, as in a legal claim to land

explanation.surface: A question about the ideal partner.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface suggests Mr Right, the perfect partner; split it into two separate definitions.
explanation.definitionFit: An honorific like Mr is a form of address, and a legal entitlement to property is also called this.

parts.note: sh is the call for silence
red is a vivid colour

explanation.surface: A call for hush beside a bright scrap.
explanation.definitionFit: A shred is a small strip or scrap torn off something.

clue.text: Very much inclined to be expensive

explanation.surface: Someone keen to spend lavishly.
explanation.definitionFit: A sharply angled slope and an excessive price are both described with this adjective.

indicators.note: from signals the letters of Peru being reworked into something new
initially picks the opening letter of escudos

explanation.surface: Cash brought from Peru, starting in escudos.
explanation.walkthrough: 'from' rearranges PERU into RUPE, then 'initially' adds E.
explanation.definitionFit: The rupee is a unit of currency used in India, Pakistan and elsewhere.

clue.text: Search into books for information about dig

definitions.meaning: turn over earth, as with a spade

explanation.surface: Looking up facts on an archaeological excavation.
explanation.definitionFit: The verb means both to research thoroughly and, in an older sense, to excavate soil.

clue.text: Child in state of unconsciousness I leave

indicators.note: leave tells us the letter I departs from the swoon

parts.note: a faint is a brief loss of consciousness
the letter I as written

explanation.surface: A youngster passes out and someone walks away.
explanation.definitionFit: An infant is a very young child, a baby.

indicators.note: coming from signals a new word produced out of the letters of Venice

explanation.surface: An exhibition arriving from the Italian city.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Show' looks like a noun, an exhibition, but it is the verb meaning reveal.
explanation.definitionFit: To evince a feeling is to reveal or display it.

clue.text: Drive out from exercises with unqualified person

parts.note: ex is Latin for out of, as in ex works
PE is physical education, school exercises
L is a learner, as on a learner driver's plate

explanation.surface: Kicking someone out of the gym class alongside a novice.
explanation.walkthrough: 'from' looks like a link word, but ex means from.
explanation.definitionFit: To expel is to force someone to leave, as from a school.

parts.note: a trike is a tricycle

explanation.surface: Hitting a second tricycle.
explanation.definitionFit: To strike is to hit or deliver a blow.

indicators.note: into places the smaller vessel inside the bigger one

parts.note: a vat is a large tank or tub
a can is a tin container

explanation.surface: Tipping a tin's contents into a big tub.
explanation.definitionFit: Vacant means unoccupied or containing nothing.

indicators.note: first puts the dish ahead of the French word

parts.note: a pie is a baked dish
ce is French for this

explanation.surface: A taste of this French dish to start.
explanation.definitionFit: A piece is a portion or part of something.

clue.text: I name complaint before ten producing continual stream

parts.note: flu is an illness, a complaint
X is the Roman numeral for ten

explanation.surface: Someone describing a long illness lasting ten days.
explanation.definitionFit: An influx is a steady flowing in of people or things.

parts.note: split the comic reporter's name as tin plus tin, and a tin is also a can, so his dance is two of those

explanation.surface: Asking what dance the boy reporter does.
explanation.walkthrough: Tintin is the Belgian comic-strip reporter, but here the name splits into tin-tin, and tin is a can.
explanation.definitionFit: The cancan is a high-kicking dance from Parisian music halls.

clue.text: Virginia has cover that's legally acceptable

parts.note: VA is the abbreviation for the US state of Virginia
a lid is a cover for a container

explanation.surface: A woman named Virginia has a lawful lid.
explanation.definitionFit: A valid document is legally binding and sound.

parts.note: someone who needs a doctor is sick

explanation.surface: A medic who is unwell yet out on parade.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is by example: soldiers do this on a parade-ground, hence the question mark.
explanation.definitionFit: Marching practice and military exercises are what take place on a parade-ground.

clue.text: It is useful for doing disheartening work

definitions.text: It is useful for doing disheartening work

parts.words: It is useful for doing disheartening work
parts.note: disheartening is read literally: removing the heart or centre of fruit

explanation.surface: A tool that helps with demoralising tasks.
explanation.definitionFit: A kitchen gadget that removes the central part of apples is what takes their hearts out.

clue.text: Cringe coming from cowcatcher losing dolly

indicators.note: losing removes the run of letters for the easy catch from the longer word

parts.note: a dolly is an easy catch in cricket

explanation.surface: Shrinking back from a locomotive's front guard that has dropped a doll.
explanation.walkthrough: A dolly is cricket slang for a simple catch; take CATCH out of COWCATCHER, the guard on the front of a train.
explanation.definitionFit: To cower is to shrink back in fear.

parts.note: suggests time travel, but means moving the opposite way to a clock's hands

explanation.surface: A question about time travel.
explanation.definitionFit: Rotating counter to the hands of a dial is going backwards on the clock face.

indicators.note: leaving signals the numeral departing from the port's name

parts.note: Alexandria is a major port on Egypt's Mediterranean coast
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A woman departs from a harbour city in Egypt.
explanation.definitionFit: Alexandra is a woman's given name, so it is an example of a lady.
